<reason>CON won a competitive debate by making the motion’s “enough” bar decide the round: safety and trust at the hour of fear, paid for without a matching and ops tax. PRO’s live route was opt-in Pareto arithmetic plus a recruiting flywheel, but CON showed the filter is least available when fear peaks, that leftover inventory and cream-skimming are not confined to the toggle, and that gender-identity ops are not “one extra field.” PRO never fully paid that complexity bill; two clipped rebuttals also left the weighing unfinished.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>B turning PRO’s “works when supply exists” concession into a fatal branding point (empty-map control is not protection), then answering A’s “name one higher-risk person” test with delay, cream-skimming, and extra night-hour exposure that break the Pareto arithmetic.</best_rebuttal>
